title: side-effect-authorization
description: Phase 3 (plan_26072506) OUTPUT contract: the stable JSON .claude/policies/runtime/completion_gate.py prints to stdout for `authorize --manifest <path> --mode experimental|promotion --action <action>`. Decides whether ONE requested side-effect action is currently authorized for a work-manifest -- a separate question from completion-manifest.schema.json's 3-state completion lifecycle (runtime-ready/evidence-complete/promotion-ready). `authorization_state` is a 2-value vocabulary PLUS null: 'execution-approved' (experimental mode only -- plan section 4.3's PRE-RUNTIME side-effect authorization: plan + HITL + scoped manifest, granted via the manifest's own execution_approval block) and 'promotion-ready' (promotion mode only -- reuses/re-executes the real `verify` evaluation and requires completion-manifest state=='promotion-ready' AND eligible_for_promotion==true). null means not authorized, for either reason: malformed/schema-invalid input or a scoped policy block (denied but well-formed) -- the two are distinguished by exit_code and reason_codes, never by a separate token. Every field this document (.claude/policies/runtime/completion_gate.py:_emit_authorization) ever includes is declared below and self-validated against this very schema before being printed (additionalProperties:false).

allOf.description: authorization_state == 'execution-approved' implies allowed, exit_code==0, and mode=='experimental' (this label is exclusive to experimental mode).
authorization_state == 'promotion-ready' implies allowed, exit_code==0, and mode=='promotion' (this label is exclusive to promotion mode).
authorization_state == null implies allowed == false and exit_code in {1, 2} -- never a success code without a named authorization_state.
exit_code == 1 (valid-but-not-approved / policy-block) implies authorization_state == null and allowed == false.
exit_code == 2 (invalid input/schema) implies authorization_state == null and allowed == false.

mode.description: Echo of --mode. null only when a CLI usage error occurred before --mode could even be parsed (e.g. missing --mode entirely).

action.description: Echo of --action. null only when a CLI usage error occurred before --action could even be parsed. hint_* values gate hint_tag.py's mutating or evidence-validating commands; read-only match remains ungated.

task_class.description: Echo of the input manifest's task_class, when it could be determined (absent/malformed manifests may leave this null).

reason_codes.description: Deterministic, sorted (lexicographic) list of stable machine-readable codes. Never contains prose.

messages.description: Human-readable prose, one entry per reason_code, keyed by code.

identity.description: Echo of the input manifest's identity block (experimental mode) or the underlying verify evaluation's identity echo (promotion mode).

exit_code.description: Mirrors the process exit code actually used (0=allowed, 1=policy-block/valid-but-not-approved, 2=invalid-input).
